errors.text_span: 左图为“生活工作域”，右图为“生理活动域”
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies the subjects of the two subplots. According to the subplot captions, the left chart (a) shows '支配动词' (controlling verbs) and the right chart (b) shows '承受动词' (patient verbs), not '生活工作域' (life/work domain) and '生理活动域' (physiological activity domain).

errors.text_span: 每个语体对应一根竖直柱
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Each category on the x-axis (e.g., 新闻 'News') corresponds to a group of two vertical bars, not a single bar.
The description cites a value of '869' for a bar total in the left chart. This value is not present in the figure; the closest similar value is 919.
The description cites a value of '437' for a bar total in the right chart. This value is not present in the figure; the closest similar value is 479.
The description claims there is a '5%' percentage label on a bar in the right chart. No such label is visible in figure (b); the visible percentages are '96%' and '97%'.
